tasks.subject: Task 0: Language core (types, registry, merge, targets, card(), renderer)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The machinery with no keywords yet except what the tests define: the keyword registry, fragment merging, target specs with casting checks and text, `card()` and the face renderer.

**Files:**
- Create: `packages/cards/src/lang/{types,registry,merge,target,card,render,index}.ts`, `packages/cards/test/{lang-helpers,lang-core}.test.ts` (helpers file is `lang-helpers.ts`)
- Test: `packages/cards/test/lang-core.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `mergeFragments` sums stat deltas, chains event handlers in order, ANDs `canCast` and `persistent`, ORs `blocksCast`, sequences `onCast`/`onExpire`, takes the last `duration`, and lets `exclusive: false` / `visible: false` win
- [ ] `defineKeyword` rejects duplicate kinds; `keywordDef` throws for an unknown kind
- [ ] `Target` builder produces immutable specs; `printTarget` prints `Swordsman.`, `Friendly recruit group.`, `Recruit group with archers.`, `Swordsman alone in its group.`, `Non-friendly group.`, `Forest square.`, `Mountain or volcano square.`, `Town or colony.`, `Globe.`
- [ ] A card's target spec enforces its casting checks in the real engine (friendly, class, group contains class, alone, terrain)
- [ ] `card()` returns a normal `CardDef` and registers a spec; `renderSpec` prints target line, then inline keywords, then line keywords

**Verify:** `cd packages/cards && npx vitest run test/lang-core.test.ts && npx tsc -p . --noEmit` -> pass

tasks.subject: Task 1: Static keywords, stat grants, and the first migration batch
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The static keyword family (`Grant`, walks, `Concealed`, `Pacified`, `Lasts`, `Stackable`, `Fleeting`, `Undispellable`, `Truce`, `Fanfare`, `Bound`, `Afterward`) and the first 23 cards migrated to keywords with identical behaviour.

**Files:**
- Create: `packages/cards/src/lang/keywords/statics.ts`, `packages/cards/test/lang-grant.test.ts`, `packages/cards/test/faces.test.ts`
- Modify: `packages/cards/src/lang/index.ts`, and the 23 card files listed in Step 6

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `Grant` adds stat deltas to every minion the spell reaches, optionally only to swordsmen, archers or enemy recruits; `{ heal: true }` also raises current hp on cast; `attacks` means hand attacks for non-archers and missile attacks for archers
- [ ] `Walk`, `Concealed`, `Pacified`, `Lasts`, `Stackable`, `Undispellable`, `Truce`, `Fleeting`, `Bound`, `Afterward` compile to the same hooks the hand-written cards used
- [ ] The 23 migrated cards print exactly the face text listed in Step 5
- [ ] The whole existing test suite (cards 157, engine 143) passes with no test edits

**Verify:** `cd C:/Users/nschonegg/Claude/sanctum && npm test && npm run typecheck` -> all pass

tasks.subject: Task 2: Triggers and effects, and the second migration batch
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The `On(trigger, ...effects)` and `OnCast(...effects)` keywords with their scopes, triggers and effect verbs, and 30 more cards migrated.

**Files:**
- Create: `packages/cards/src/lang/{scopes,effects,triggers}.ts`, `packages/cards/src/lang/keywords/trigger.ts`, `packages/cards/test/lang-effects.test.ts`
- Modify: `packages/cards/src/lang/index.ts`, `packages/cards/test/{lang-helpers,faces}.test.ts` (helpers file is `lang-helpers.ts`), and the 30 card files in Step 7

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Every effect verb behaves like the hand-written code it replaces: `Heal` (amount or `'full'`), `Damage`, `Kill`, `Terraform` (target / adjacent / contiguous), `Expend`, `DispelAll` (visible spells only), `AddMana` (to the caster or the structure's owner), `Give` (once or repeated), `GiveSquares`, `Withdraw`, `MoveTwice`, `RandomMove`, `CancelMoves`
- [ ] Triggers fire on the right events and only for the host: start of turn, start of combat (optionally vs monsters), each round (optionally one round), after all combat, before movement, mana phase, on enter (optionally recruit groups), recruit created, on hit, on damage (optionally to monsters)
- [ ] The 30 migrated cards print the face text listed in Step 6
- [ ] The whole existing suite passes with no test edits

**Verify:** `cd C:/Users/nschonegg/Claude/sanctum && npm test && npm run typecheck` -> all pass

tasks.subject: Task 3: Restriction keywords and the third migration batch
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `Forbid`, `Shroud`, `Warded` and `Concealment`, and ten cards migrated.

**Files:**
- Create: `packages/cards/src/lang/keywords/restrict.ts`, `packages/cards/test/lang-restrict.test.ts`
- Modify: `packages/cards/src/lang/index.ts`, `packages/cards/test/faces.test.ts`, and the 10 card files in Step 5

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `Forbid(spells, { by, friendly })` blocks casts by class (globe, structure, group, individual), optionally only the caster's, optionally only on friendly targets
- [ ] `Shroud` protects a host group (and its members) or a host minion (and its group) from group and/or individual spells, optionally only friendly ones
- [ ] `Warded()` cancels combat damage from unenchanted recruits after armor; `Warded(n)` reduces it by n before armor
- [ ] `Concealment()` blocks individual spells on all minions (except sight-ignoring cards)
- [ ] The ten migrated cards print the text in Step 4 and pass their existing tests unchanged

tasks.subject: Task 4: Ramp, Script, and the last five cards
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The `Ramp` keyword (the Rage mechanic) and the `Script` escape hatch, and the last five hand-written cards migrated, leaving no card written with `defineCard`.

**Files:**
- Create: `packages/cards/src/lang/keywords/special.ts`, `packages/cards/test/lang-special.test.ts`
- Modify: `packages/cards/src/lang/index.ts`, `packages/cards/test/faces.test.ts`, and the 5 card files in Step 4
